#
# Evaluation environment for DN-MOPD (vLLM generation + graders + aggregation).
# Python 3.10, Linux x86_64, NVIDIA GPU with a CUDA 12.8-capable driver.
#
#   pip install -r env/requirements-eval.txt -c env/constraints-eval.txt
#   python -m eval.external.fetch         # official checkers + nltk data at pinned commits (sha256-verified)
#
# Everything resolves from public PyPI. vllm 0.18.0 pulls the PyPI build of torch 2.10.0, which is the CUDA 12.8
# build. env/constraints-eval.txt is the full frozen package list of the paper's generation environment.
#
# Graders. In the paper, generation ran in this environment; the math and LiveCodeBench grading ran with the same
# math-verify 0.9.0 in the training environment, and the IFEval/IFBench checkers ran with the pure-Python packages
# pinned below. Installing everything here lets one environment both generate and grade. For that, the ANTLR runtime
# is the math-grading environment's 4.9.3 rather than the generation environment's 4.13.2: math-verify parses LaTeX
# through it, and with 4.13.2 some answers grade differently from the paper's records.
#
# NOT installed from this file (fetched by `python -m eval.external.fetch`, pinned in eval/external/PINS.json):
#   * LiveCodeBench runner (lcb_runner): github.com/LiveCodeBench/LiveCodeBench @ 28fef95
#   * IFEval official checker: github.com/google-research/google-research, instruction_following_eval/ @ b24f2136
#   * IFBench official checker: github.com/allenai/IFBench @ 1091c4c3

# ---- Generation ----

triton==3.6.0

safetensors==0.7.0

compressed-tensors==0.13.0
numpy==2.2.6
datasets==4.8.4
pyarrow==24.0.0
PyYAML==6.0.3
tqdm==4.67.3

# ---- Math grader ----
math-verify==0.9.0
latex2sympy2_extended==1.11.0
sympy==1.14.0
antlr4-python3-runtime==4.9.3      # the paper's math-grading runtime (the generation env had 4.13.2)

# ---- IFEval / IFBench official checkers (versions used in the paper) ----
absl-py==2.5.0

# ---- Aggregation and paired bootstrap ----
pandas==2.3.3

# ---- Tests ----
